exposure: Maternal double burden of overweight and short stature
cohort: The study participants were married women aged 15 to 49 years from nationally representative Demographic and Health Survey databases of Bangladesh, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Pakistan.
finding: Maternal double burden of overweight and short stature was significantly associated with a 179% higher likelihood of undergoing cesarean birth in South Asia.
mod_finding: The negative effect of the maternal double burden of overweight and short stature on the risk of cesarean birth extends across all economic backgrounds, not being limited to low socioeconomic status mothers.
cross-section timing: N/A (data obtained from existing national Demographic and Health Survey databases, specific collection dates not provided)
